softwareInnerHero.title: Microsoft 365 Apps
paragraphs: Microsoft 365 Apps (formerly Office 365 ProPlus) is the cloud-connected version of Microsoft’s essential productivity applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, OneNote, and more. Delivered as a subscription service, it provides the familiar, powerful tools that individuals and businesses rely on daily, enhanced with cloud capabilities for collaboration, security, and accessibility across all devices.
